# Diagnostics & Plotting Functions

Functions defined in `R/diagnostics.R`.

---

## `plot_inla_model()`

Diagnostic plot for a fitted `weighted_inla_traffic_model` (from
`fit_weighted_inla_model()`): predicted-vs-observed, residuals-vs-fitted, Q-Q, or a
residual histogram, each annotated with RMSE/MAE/MAPE/MALE.

```r
plot_inla_model(
  model,
  observed,
  test_idx = NULL,
  type     = c("pred_vs_obs", "residuals_vs_fitted", "qq", "residuals_hist"),
  title    = NULL,
  col      = "#0066CC",
  x_label  = NULL,
  y_label  = NULL,
  ylim     = NULL
)
```

### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `model` | `weighted_inla_traffic_model` | Object returned by `fit_weighted_inla_model()` |
| `observed` | numeric vector | True AADT values, full-length, same row order as the data passed to `fit_weighted_inla_model()` |
| `test_idx` | integer vector or NULL | Optional subset (e.g. held-out test rows) to restrict the plot to |
| `type` | character | `"pred_vs_obs"` (default), `"residuals_vs_fitted"`, `"qq"`, or `"residuals_hist"` |
| `title` | character or NULL | Auto-generated from `model$family`/`model$spatial_term` if `NULL` |
| `col` | character | Hex colour for points (default `"#0066CC"`) |
| `x_label`, `y_label` | character or NULL | Override axis labels |
| `ylim` | numeric length-2 or NULL | Restrict y-axis range |

### Returns

A `ggplot` object, printed automatically and also returned invisibly.

---

## `plot_kfold_cv()`

Diagnostic plots for a `kfold_cv_inla()` result: predicted-vs-observed (coloured and
labelled by fold with per-fold metrics), residuals-vs-fitted, Q-Q, residual histogram, or a
per-fold RMSE/MAE/MAPE/MALE bar chart faceted by metric.

```r
plot_kfold_cv(
  cv_result,
  type = c("pred_vs_obs", "residuals_vs_fitted", "qq",
           "residuals_hist", "metrics_by_fold")
)
```

### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `cv_result` | `inla_kfold_cv` | Object returned by `kfold_cv_inla()` |
| `type` | character | `"pred_vs_obs"` (default), `"residuals_vs_fitted"`, `"qq"`, `"residuals_hist"`, or `"metrics_by_fold"` |

### Returns

A `ggplot` object, printed automatically and also returned invisibly.

---

## `plot_sensor_selection_map()`

Interactive `leaflet` map of a sensor-selection result. Draws selected sensors (red),
optional flow-conservation-derived links (orange), 1..H-hop neighbour context links
(blue, one layer per hop), and — when `all_data` is supplied — a dashed overlay of all
currently measured links. Numbered, permanently-visible circle markers are placed at the
midpoint of each selected/derived sensor, ranked by `mi_score` (or by bundle score when
the input comes from `greedy_mi_sensor_selection_derivable()`).

```r
plot_sensor_selection_map(
  sensor_results,
  color_selected     = "#E63946",
  color_neighbour    = "#457B9D",
  color_derived      = "#F4A261",
  weight_selected    = 6,
  weight_neighbour   = 3,
  opacity_selected   = 0.95,
  opacity_neighbour  = 0.7,
  all_data           = NULL,
  color_measured     = "#FF00FF"
)
```

### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `sensor_results` | list or data frame | List from `greedy_mi_sensor_selection_norway()` (must contain `$selected_data_entries`), or that data frame directly |
| `color_selected` | character | Hex colour for selected sensor links (default `"#E63946"`) |
| `color_neighbour` | character | Hex colour for neighbour context links (default `"#457B9D"`) |
| `color_derived` | character | Hex colour for flow-conservation-derived links (default `"#F4A261"`) |
| `weight_selected`, `weight_neighbour` | numeric | Polyline weights (default 6 / 3) |
| `opacity_selected`, `opacity_neighbour` | numeric | Polyline opacities (default 0.95 / 0.7) |
| `all_data` | data frame or NULL | Full traffic links data frame; when supplied, adds a dashed overlay of all measured links (layer "Målte trafikklenker") |
| `color_measured` | character | Hex colour for the measured-links dash overlay (default `"#FF00FF"`) |

### Returns

A `leaflet` map object with toggleable layer groups and a legend.

## `map_traffic_links()`

General-purpose interactive `leaflet` map of any traffic-links data frame, colouring by an
arbitrary `color_by` column (categorical → `colorFactor`/`"Set1"`, numeric →
`colorNumeric`/`"viridis"`). Popup content mirrors `xdtkit::plot_traffic_links_map`
(link ID, predicted AADT/SD — preferring `balanced_pred`/`balanced_sd` over
`inla_pred`/`inla_sd` when present, relative uncertainty, measured AADT + source,
last-year AADT), with any missing fields silently omitted.

```r
map_traffic_links(
  data,
  color_by,
  title   = color_by,
  weight  = 2,
  opacity = 0.9
)
```

### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `data` | data frame | Must have an `id` column compatible with `add_geometries()` |
| `color_by` | character | Column name used for colouring links |
| `title` | character | Legend title (defaults to `color_by`) |
| `weight` | numeric | Polyline weight (default 2) |
| `opacity` | numeric | Polyline opacity (default 0.9) |

### Returns

A `leaflet` map object.
